rationale: Three lenses ran (blind, edge-case, acceptance). Acceptance: both ticket criteria pass and all plan Global Constraints are respected. Edge-case confirmed one real defect with a probe test and mutation testing, independently raised by the blind lens: in RecordInput two consecutive removals can produce a byte-identical announcement string, so React bails out, the live region's text never changes and screen readers stay silent on the most important removal (deleting the last row). 7 further blind-lens findings were dismissed after verification against source: uploadedFiles has a `= []` default; MAX_FILES is enforced against the combined total; the delete Button carries disabled={disabled} so the missing guard is unreachable; toHaveTextContent('') is not vacuous in jest-dom 6.6.3 (probe-verified: it fails against non-empty text); async uploadedFiles hydration cannot announce because FilesDropzone only mounts after reset(); the hardcoded 10 in tests and the re-seed wording are style-level. 0 deferred.

business_review.notes: RecordInput is handler-driven so the auto-seed effect cannot announce; FilesDropzone skips the first effect run. Both covered by tests.

standards_review.notes: Both subjects match ^EPMCDME-\d+: [A-Z]... — 'EPMCDME-8560: Announce added and removed rows in RecordInput' and 'EPMCDME-8560: Announce file list changes in FilesDropzone'.

No such guide in this repo. Change is presentation-only: no auth, secrets, network, or user-controlled HTML. No concrete security issue found.

findings.problem: removeItem re-seeds an empty row when the list empties, so removing the last row produces 'Row removed. 1 row total.' — byte-identical to the message from the previous removal that left one row. setAnnouncement is then a no-op bail-out, the live region's text node never changes, and screen readers do not re-announce.
findings.impact: The most significant removal (deleting the last key/value row, which wipes its content) gives screen-reader users no feedback — exactly the WCAG 4.1.3 status change this ticket exists to fix. Affects SettingsForm MCP env vars and HedgingConfig.
findings.recommendation: Make consecutive announcements distinguishable regardless of message text — e.g. alternate between two sr-only status regions so each message is written into a region that was previously empty. Strengthen the re-seed test to start from two rows and delete both.
